summary: Validated bug fix for customer agimk@me.com login - false 'Du bist offline' banner no longer appears. Frontend auth/network handling fix confirmed working. Login flow completes successfully without false offline blocker.
critical_code_review_comments: api.js correctly removed pre-request navigator.onLine hard block - now emits bidblitz-network-status based on real request outcomes
NetworkContext.jsx correctly listens to both browser online/offline events AND custom bidblitz-network-status event
Offline banner (data-testid='offline-banner') only appears when real network failures occur, not as false preflight gate
Auth errors (401) correctly surface as auth errors, not as offline errors
context_for_next_testing_agent: Customer offline-guard regression fix validated. Key testids: auth-page, login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-btn, offline-banner. The offline-banner should only appear when real network failures occur (Failed to fetch), not as a preflight gate based on navigator.onLine. api.js emits bidblitz-network-status events based on actual request success/failure.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause was api.js checking navigator.onLine before making requests and blocking with offline error. Fix removed this preflight check and now relies on actual request outcomes to determine network status.
